shortDescription: An account with more than $30,000 in cumulative losses bought contracts on the Federal Reserve holding rates unchanged in October. According to Odaily, the account purchased 377,658.3 shares at an average price of 85.5 cents, and its wallet address is 0x88b21efc4aa4e08cdc125300ad6b3a520811e1d1.
